title: Capture run resolution report
description: What one carla-capture launch resolved, every field with the layer that set it, and every finding of the offline checks. Written beside the run result as <stem>.resolution.json on every path, whether the launch was accepted or refused. Not the scenario compiler's <scenario>.resolution.json.

resolution_version.description: The format version of this file.

producer.description: What wrote the file: the tool and its release, the carlanet release, the CARLA server and the SUMO release where they were used, and when. A file written before 2026-10-07 has none.

tool.description: The component that wrote the file, such as carlacontrol.ScenarioCompiler.

tool_version.description: The carlacontrol release the tool is from, with the commit it was built at.

carlanet.description: The release of the CarlaNet libraries the process loaded; null where it loaded none.

server.description: The CARLA server's build identity where the writer reached a server; null where it reached none. Where the identity could not be had it is available false, with the release, the world interface and the reason.

sumo.description: The SUMO release where SUMO ran; null where it did not.

written_utc.description: When the file was written, ISO 8601 in UTC. Left out of a file that two runs of one input must write byte for byte.

outcome.description: accepted: the offline checks passed and the lock was written. usage_error or refused_offline: the launch stopped here.

session_id.description: The run's identity, as in the run result.

check_catalogue.description: The catalogue the findings' check numbers belong to: carla-capture run checks.

findings.description: Every refusal and warning, in the order made.

launch_echo.description: The launch echo; null where the offline checks refused first.

effective_configuration.description: Every field, its value and where it came from; null where nothing resolved.

launch_echo.description: What the run is about to do, stated before anything is acquired.

launch_echo_version.description: The format version of this block.

lock.description: The scenario as <scenario_id>@<first 12 digits of its lock's SHA-256>.

window.description: The declared window's id, or explicit.

dry_run.description: What the scenario lock records of the compiler's SUMO-only run.

ran.description: Whether the compile ran the scenario in SUMO alone.

skipped_accepted.description: Whether a skipped run was accepted for this launch.

begin_s.description: Where the window begins, simulated seconds.

prewarm_s.description: Seconds rendered before the window and not recorded.

captures.description: The captures the window will make.

capture_hz.description: Captures per simulated second on each channel.

frames_per_hour.description: Captures per simulated hour over every channel.

begin.description: The window's begin in civil time, ISO 8601 with offset.

anyOf.description: A policy that binds no sun: the world's own is left as it is.
A policy that binds the sun, and the sun at the window's first and last instant.

advances.description: Whether the sun moves across the window.

rate.description: Sun-clock seconds per simulated second, under advance.

elevation_kind.description: What the elevations are: refraction-corrected or geometric.

window_open_s.description: The simulated second the window opens and the sun is bound.

held_at.description: The sun's date and clock where it is held.

held_at_note.description: When the sun is pinned, and what the prewarm is lit by.

sun.description: The policy holding the sun, and the sun it binds.

origin.description: [latitude, longitude] of the map's origin, degrees.

render.description: What is rendered: the render set's fields as resolved.

limited.description: Whether an optional limit leaves vehicles without a body.

vehicles.description: Which vehicles get a body, in words.

left_out.description: What a limit leaves out; null with no limit.

cost.description: The disk the window will cost.

estimated_bytes.description: The window's estimated size on disk.

free_bytes.description: Free space where captures are written.

headroom_s.description: Captured seconds the free space holds.

readiness.description: The wait for every channel's view before the window opens.

tiles.description: What a view's tiles being in means.

picture_settled_wait.description: Whether the picture is also waited on.

picture.description: What the picture's wait compares, or that it is not run.

tiles_ceiling_s.description: Wall-clock seconds a view has for its tiles.

tiles_hold_s.description: The tiles' lead before the window, simulated seconds.

from_s.description: The simulated second the wait begins.

until_s.description: The simulated second the window opens.

traffic_stare_holds_from_s.description: Where a stare aimed at the traffic holds its pose; null with no such stare.

warnings.description: The codes of the warnings the offline checks raised.

not_predicted.description: What the echo cannot say before the run.

check.description: The run check's number in the carla-capture run checks.

outcome.description: refuse: the launch stops. warn: it goes on, and the warning must be adjudicated.

subject.description: What the finding is about: a field path, a channel, a package.

catalogue.description: The catalogue the check belongs to: carla-capture run checks.

code.description: A warning's code, which on_warning.<code> adjudicates. Present on a warning only.

effective_configuration.description: Every field the run is subject to, its value, the layer that set it and where that layer read it.

effective_configuration_version.description: The format version of this block.

tool_version.description: The carlacontrol release that resolved it.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the replayable run configuration.

fields.description: Every run configuration field, keyed by its dotted path.

items.description: One channel, every field of it.

channels.description: Each channel's fields, in the order declared.

value.description: The value the run uses, of the field's type in the run configuration's schema; null where the field does not apply or nothing supplied it.

layer.description: The layer that set it: a configuration layer, or derived, pinned_by_policy, not_applicable or unsupplied.

provenance.description: The file and key, or the command-line text, it was read from.

overridden.description: What lower layers gave and a higher one replaced; null where nothing was replaced.

dropped.description: An illumination value of a lower layer dropped because a higher layer chose a policy that does not take it.

note.description: A note, such as a binding restated with the same value.

environment_variable.description: The environment variable the value was read from.

resolved_field.description: One field: its value, the layer that set it and where that layer read it.

value.description: The value the run uses, of the field's type in the run configuration's schema; null where the field does not apply or nothing supplied it.

environment_variable.description: The environment variable the value was read from.

tool_default.description: The tool's default, carried even where another layer set the value.

resolved_field_with_default.description: One field: its value, the layer that set it and where that layer read it, and the tool's default.

site_profile.description: This machine's facts as the launch resolved them, each with where it came from.

source.description: The profile file the values were read from, or the layout they were derived from.

declared_environment.description: The environment variables the profile file names.

host_searched.description: The variables the session searches for SUMO because no field names one; empty where a field does.

values.description: Every machine fact, keyed by its run configuration field.

value.description: The value the launch uses: text, a number, or null.
